usage_notes: Every field below is exactly extracted from the retained v2.1 workbook; headings and source values are preserved. Normalized metadata only makes the same source values easier to render.
The 282 baseline starter FLD fields are a different namespace from the 282 DOL F-* field records. Never merge them by matching count or label.

Narrative or mixed types are retained as source specification, not silently converted to implemented database types. Customer-specific mapping and actual values remain blank or unverified as supplied.
Use a protected, searchable reference explorer. These entries are field specifications, not a mandate to collect all personal data or claim a deployed schema.
The 24 decision records preserve original status and authority fields. Viewing, editing a draft or clicking a UI button must not create approval.
